note: Absa Bank Zambia's personal banking tariff guide (effective 1 July 2026): its Classic credit card costs K200 a year, nothing to join, and charges 3.5% a month on purchases. The guide's text is drawn as outlines, so it was read by eye.

sources.title: Absa Bank Zambia, Personal Banking Tariff Guide (effective 1 July 2026)
sources.said: Absa Credit Card. Fees/Card: Classic, Platinum. Joining Fee: Free, Free. Annual Fee: 200, 400. Purchase Interest Rate per Month: 3.5%, 3.5%. (Read by eye from the one-page guide, headed Personal Banking Tariff Guide, Effective 1 July 2026, whose text is drawn as outlines.)
